name: data-cleaner
description: Clean, normalize, and validate spreadsheet-like data with local Helix skills.

interface.shortDescription: Clean and validate table data with Skill-only workflows.
interface.longDescription: Data Cleaner is a Skill-only plugin. It adds local instructions for profiling columns, normalizing values, detecting duplicates, and producing data-quality summaries without declaring any MCP server.
